study.comparator: cardiovascular risk factor management without liraglutide (open label control)
study.notes: STUDY: STARDUST (NCT04881110), single centre open label randomised trial (Naples) in adults with type 2 diabetes and peripheral artery disease (TcPO2 30 to 49 mmHg, HbA1c 6.5 to 8.0 percent): liraglutide titrated to 1.8 mg daily (dose_mg 1.8) vs management of cardiovascular risk factors alone, 60 randomised (30 per arm), 55 analysed at 6 months and 27 vs 28 at 18 months (Table 4 column headers); this 18 month follow up report gives per arm mean (SD) changes and the estimated treatment difference with 95 percent CI at 6 months (Table 3) and 18 months (Table 4); rows at 18 months, 78 weeks, the longest on treatment timepoint (brief rule 1), with the 6 month values in the notes (route ci_95, MD in the printed units); laboratory staff blinded to allocation; CRP, IL-6 and TNF-alpha are prespecified additional outcomes (prespecified TRUE); baselines in Table 1 are medians (IQR) for CRP 0.4 and 0.4 mg/dL, IL-6 44.7 and 43.9 pg/mL, TNF-alpha 9.1 and 9.6 pg/mL (no mean denominators); body weight change not printed as a contrast, pct_weight_change empty (Table 4 weights 80.9 vs 81.9 kg at 18 months); funded by a university PhD programme (industry_funded FALSE); rob_overall some_concerns

rows.notes: Table 4: CRP mg/dL change at 18 months, liraglutide minus 0.4 (0.6) vs control minus 0.05 (0.5), estimated treatment difference minus 0.5 (minus 0.8 to minus 0.2), p 0.002; 6 months (Table 3) minus 0.4 (minus 0.7 to minus 0.07), p 0.018; high sensitivity CRP by ELISA, baseline medians 0.4 and 0.4 mg/dL

Table 4: IL-6 pg/mL change at 18 months, liraglutide minus 49.3 (54.6) vs control minus 16.8 (19.0), estimated treatment difference minus 32.6 (minus 54.6 to minus 10.5), p 0.004; 6 months minus 31.6 (minus 54.6 to minus 8.7); baseline medians 44.7 and 43.9 pg/mL (high for an ELISA, as printed)

Table 4: TNF-alpha pg/mL change at 18 months, liraglutide minus 32.9 (43.3) vs control minus 28.9 (42.3), estimated treatment difference minus 3.9 (minus 27.4 to 19.4), p 0.734; 6 months minus 4.4 (minus 26.6 to 17.6); baseline medians 9.1 and 9.6 pg/mL

json.design: single centre open label randomised trial, liraglutide 1.8 mg vs risk factor management, type 2 diabetes with peripheral artery disease, 60 randomised, 18 month follow up
json.reason: full text group (institutional route); three inventory markers (CRP, IL-6, TNF-alpha) as estimated treatment differences with 95 percent CI at 18 months from Table 4
biomarkers_reported_no_variance: HbA1c, SBP, DBP, LDL, TG, eGFR (Table 4 values at 18 months per arm as mean plus or minus SD or median, no baseline to pair and no contrast printed)
other_markers: circulating progenitor and endothelial progenitor cells

rob.justification: randomised trial with concealed laboratory assessment (D1 low); open label with risk factor prescriptions in both arms (D2 some concerns); 5 of 60 withdrew and 55 analysed (D3 some concerns); laboratory staff blinded (D4 low); registered trial with named secondary outcomes (D5 low)

doubts: IL-6 baseline medians near 44 pg/mL are far above usual circulating values; the ELISA values are entered as printed in pg/mL
the CRP contrast is in mg/dL with median baselines only, so it converts to percent only through the hand keyed BASELINE table
the 6 month primary report (Caruso 2024) may be a separate record of the corpus; the 18 month values are entered here
